answer: Weight votes by content similarity. Each epoch every answer is clustered with the rest, and a near-duplicate cluster's combined vote weight is divided by its size - ten templated copies carry the weight of one original. For an attacker, cloned accounts earn nothing unless each writes genuinely distinct, on-topic text every epoch, while templating zeroes out. A juniper grove of clones decays to one seed's weight; the signal a vote carries - opal-grade freshness of thought - is what a sybil must pay in, not account count.
